+# ===========================================================================
+# SELF-HOSTING — COMPOSITION rung 9: verified DECLARATION front-end + lowering
+# ===========================================================================
+# Rung 8 used the verified `selfhost_parse` for clause *bodies* but still split
+# declarations (def heads / clauses) with driver-local code. This rung replaces
+# that last toy front-end piece with the equivalence-locked `selfhost_decl` port,
+# which parses a WHOLE program (def heads, params, multi-clause patterns incl.
+# cons-lists, expressions) into a `Decl` IR. The driver then lowers that IR to
+# `selfhost_beam` Core and runs it through the verified backend (rung 7):
+#
+#   lex(src) → SelfhostDecl.parse_program(toks)   ← the REAL declaration parser
+#            → normalize/group clauses by name
+#            → lower Decl IR → selfhost_beam Core/Pat   (the surface→Core lowering)
+#            → SelfhostBeam.compile_forms(funcs)        ← the REAL backend
+#            → inflate Form → abstract-form tuples (in Rian)
+#            → :compile.forms / :code.load_binary
+#
+# Now BOTH the front-end (parsing: lex→SelfhostDecl) and the back-end (codegen:
+# SelfhostBeam) are equivalence-locked ports. The only driver-local glue is the
+# lexer, the surface→Core lowering, and the Form inflater — none of which
+# reimplements a verified stage. Two verified ports, composed.
+#
+# selfhost_decl's surface is arithmetic + calls + multi-clause patterns + cons
+# LISTS (no `if` — that was rung 8's selfhost_parse). So this rung compiles e.g.
+#   def sum([]) := 0
+#   def sum([h | t]) := h + sum(t)
+# — list-pattern recursion, beyond rung 8's surface. Both `SelfhostDecl` and
+# `SelfhostBeam` load under their :"Elixir.Selfhost*" atoms (Pascal calls,
+# ADR-0041); both are sibling ports, so the calls are composition, not host
+# crutches (excluded from the FFI ledger). Only host FFI: :compile.forms /
+# :code.load_binary.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+mod SelfhostComposeRealDecl do
+  # ── selfhost_decl's Tok (the subset the driver emits; tags must match) ──
+  type Tok := TNum(String) | TId(String) | TKw(String) | TOp(String)
+            | TLP | TRP | TLBracket | TRBracket | TComma | TNL
+
+  # ── selfhost_beam's INPUT IR (the shared contract — structurally identical) ──
+  type Core := CNum(String)
+             | CId(String)
+             | CAtom(String)
+             | CUnary(String, Core)
+             | CBin(String, Core, Core)
+             | CCall(String, Vec(Core))
+             | CTuple(Vec(Core))
+             | CList(Vec(Core), Tail)
+             | CIf(Core, Block, Block)
+             | CCase(Core, Vec(Arm))
+
+  type Tail := TClose | TTail(Core)
+  type Block := Block(Vec(Stmt))
+  type Stmt := SBind(String, Core) | STypedBind(String, String, Core) | SExpr(Core)
+  type Arm := Arm(Pat, Guard, Block)
+
+  type Pat := PWild
+            | PVar(String)
+            | PInt(Int53)
+            | PAtom(String)
+            | PCtor(String, Vec(Pat))
+            | PTuple(Vec(Pat))
+            | PList(Vec(Pat), PTail)
+
+  type PTail := PtlClose | PtlTail(Pat)
+  type Guard := GNone | GSome(Core)
+  type Clause := Clause(Vec(Pat), Guard, Block)
+  type Func := Func(String, Int53, Vec(Clause))
+
+  # ── selfhost_beam's OUTPUT (the string-carrying Form sum we inflate) ──
+  type Form := FInt(Int53)
+             | FVar(String)
+             | FAtom(String)
+             | FCtorN(String)
+             | FCtor(String, Vec(Form))
+             | FOp1(String, Form)
+             | FOp2(String, Form, Form)
+             | FCall(String, Vec(Form))
+             | FTuple(Vec(Form))
+             | FNil
+             | FCons(Form, Form)
+             | FIf(Form, Vec(Form), Vec(Form))
+             | FCase(Form, Vec(FClause))
+             | FMatch(String, Form)
+
+  type GForm := GfNone | GfSome(Form)
+  type FClause := FClause(Vec(Form), GForm, Vec(Form))
+  type FFunc := FFunc(String, Int53, Vec(FClause))
+
+  # ── driver-local types ──
+  # a normalized clause (name, lowered head patterns, lowered body) + a per-fn group.
+  type NClause := NC(String, Vec(Pat), Core)
+  type Grp := Grp(String, Int53, Vec(NClause))
+
+  # ── the BEAM toolchain boundary: two @external(:ex) host calls (counted FFI) ──
+  @external(:ex, ":compile.forms(forms, [:return_errors])")
+  def compile_forms_host(forms Vec(Tuple)) Tuple
+
+  @external(:ex, ":code.load_binary(name, chars, bin)")
+  def load_binary(name Symbol, chars Vec(Int53), bin String) Tuple
+
+  # ── the driver: source -> a loaded, runnable module ──
+  pub def build(src String, modname Symbol) Symbol
+  pub def build(src, modname)
+    case compile_forms_host(compile_module(src, modname)) do
+      {:ok, m, bin} -> loaded(load_binary(m, Prim.str_chars("nofile"), bin))
+    end
+  end
+
+  def loaded(Tuple) Symbol
+  def loaded({:module, m}) := m
+
+  # ── source -> a full :compile.forms input, via the REAL decl parser + backend ──
+  pub def compile_module(src String, modname Symbol) Vec(Tuple)
+  pub def compile_module(src, modname) := assemble(modname, funcs(group(normalize(SelfhostDecl.parse_program(lex(src))))))
+
+  def assemble(modname Symbol, fs Vec(Func)) Vec(Tuple) := [{:attribute, 0, :module, modname}, {:attribute, 0, :export, exports(fs)} | inflate_funcs(SelfhostBeam.compile_forms(fs))]
+
+  def exports(Vec(Func)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def exports([]) := []
+  def exports([Func(name, arity, _) | rest]) := [{Prim.str_to_atom(name), arity} | exports(rest)]
+
+  # ── stage 1: lex (String -> selfhost_decl Tok, with significant newlines) ──
+  pub def lex(s String) Vec(Tok) := lex_chars(Prim.str_chars(s))
+
+  def lex_chars(Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex_chars([]) := []
+  def lex_chars([c | rest])
+    if c == 32 or c == 13 do
+      lex_chars(rest)
+    else
+      lex_nl_or(c, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  # newline is a SIGNIFICANT token (TNL) — selfhost_decl splits declarations on it.
+  def lex_nl_or(c Int53, rest Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex_nl_or(c, rest)
+    if c == 10 do
+      [TNL | lex_chars(rest)]
+    else
+      classify(c, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def classify(c Int53, rest Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def classify(c, rest)
+    if is_digit(c) do
+      take_num([c | rest], [])
+    else
+      lex_alpha_or_op(c, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def lex_alpha_or_op(c Int53, rest Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex_alpha_or_op(c, rest)
+    if is_alpha(c) do
+      take_id([c | rest], [])
+    else
+      take_op([c | rest])
+    end
+  end
+
+  def take_num(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_num([], acc) := [TNum(text(acc))]
+  def take_num([c | rest], acc)
+    if is_digit(c) do
+      take_num(rest, [c | acc])
+    else
+      [TNum(text(acc)) | lex_chars([c | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def take_id(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_id([], acc) := [id_tok(text(acc))]
+  def take_id([c | rest], acc)
+    if is_alnum(c) do
+      take_id(rest, [c | acc])
+    else
+      [id_tok(text(acc)) | lex_chars([c | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  # `def`/`pub` are keywords; `_` is an identifier (selfhost_decl maps TId("_") to
+  # the wildcard pattern); everything else is an identifier.
+  def id_tok(String) Tok
+  def id_tok("def") := TKw("def")
+  def id_tok("pub") := TKw("pub")
+  def id_tok(s) := TId(s)
+
+  # `:=` then punctuation; `[`/`]` for lists, `|` (the cons bar) falls to TOp.
+  def take_op(Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_op([58, 61 | rest]) := [TOp(":=") | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([44 | rest]) := [TComma | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([40 | rest]) := [TLP | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([41 | rest]) := [TRP | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([91 | rest]) := [TLBracket | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([93 | rest]) := [TRBracket | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([c | rest]) := [TOp(Prim.str_from_chars([c])) | lex_chars(rest)]
+
+  def text(acc Vec(Int53)) String := Prim.str_from_chars(rev_codes(acc, []))
+
+  def rev_codes(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Int53)
+  def rev_codes([], out) := out
+  def rev_codes([c | rest], out) := rev_codes(rest, [c | out])
+
+  def is_digit(c Int53) Bool := c >= 48 and c <= 57
+  def is_alpha(c Int53) Bool := (c >= 65 and c <= 90) or (c >= 97 and c <= 122) or c == 95
+  def is_alnum(c Int53) Bool := is_alpha(c) or is_digit(c)
+
+  # ── normalize: selfhost_decl's Decl IR -> a flat list of (name, pats, body) ──
+  # only function clauses matter; DSig/DType/DStruct/DMod/guarded clauses are skipped
+  # (the corpus has none). `p`/`ds` are untyped — the cross-module values are raw
+  # tuples/atoms the driver pattern-matches directly.
+  def normalize(ds) Vec(NClause)
+  def normalize([]) := []
+  def normalize([{:d_clause, name, pats, expr} | rest]) := [NC(name, lower_pats(pats), lower_surface(expr)) | normalize(rest)]
+  def normalize([_ | rest]) := normalize(rest)
+
+  # ── the surface→Core lowering: selfhost_decl Pat/Expr -> selfhost_beam Pat/Core ──
+  def lower_pats(ps) Vec(Pat)
+  def lower_pats([]) := []
+  def lower_pats([p | rest]) := [lower_pat(p) | lower_pats(rest)]
+
+  def lower_pat(p) Pat
+  def lower_pat(:wild) := PWild
+  def lower_pat(:nil_p) := PList([], PtlClose)
+  def lower_pat({:var, n}) := PVar(n)
+  def lower_pat({:lit, k}) := PInt(k)
+  def lower_pat({:ctor, c, ps}) := PCtor(c, lower_pats(ps))
+  def lower_pat({:cons_p, h, t}) := cons_pat([lower_pat(h)], t)
+
+  # flatten a cons-pattern chain `[a, b | tl]` into PList([a, b], tail).
+  def cons_pat(acc Vec(Pat), t) Pat
+  def cons_pat(acc, :nil_p) := PList(rev_pats(acc, []), PtlClose)
+  def cons_pat(acc, {:cons_p, h, t}) := cons_pat([lower_pat(h) | acc], t)
+  def cons_pat(acc, other) := PList(rev_pats(acc, []), PtlTail(lower_pat(other)))
+
+  def rev_pats(Vec(Pat), Vec(Pat)) Vec(Pat)
+  def rev_pats([], out) := out
+  def rev_pats([p | rest], out) := rev_pats(rest, [p | out])
+
+  # expressions: `{:num,s}` `{:id,x}` `{:bin,op,l,r}` `{:unary,op,x}`
+  # `{:call,{:id,f},args}` — the subset selfhost_decl bodies produce here.
+  def lower_surface(e) Core
+  def lower_surface({:num, s}) := CNum(s)
+  def lower_surface({:id, x}) := CId(x)
+  def lower_surface({:bin, op, l, r}) := CBin(op, lower_surface(l), lower_surface(r))
+  def lower_surface({:unary, op, x}) := CUnary(op, lower_surface(x))
+  def lower_surface({:call, callee, args}) := CCall(callee_name(callee), lower_all(args))
+
+  def callee_name(c) String
+  def callee_name({:id, f}) := f
+
+  def lower_all(es) Vec(Core)
+  def lower_all([]) := []
+  def lower_all([e | rest]) := [lower_surface(e) | lower_all(rest)]
+
+  # ── group consecutive same-name clauses, wrap each as a beam Func ──
+  def group(Vec(NClause)) Vec(Grp)
+  def group([]) := []
+  def group([NC(name, pats, body) | rest]) := group_run(name, plen(pats), [NC(name, pats, body)], rest)
+
+  def group_run(name String, arity Int53, acc Vec(NClause), Vec(NClause)) Vec(Grp)
+  def group_run(name, arity, acc, []) := [Grp(name, arity, rev_ncs(acc, []))]
+  def group_run(name, arity, acc, [NC(n2, p2, b2) | rest])
+    if name == n2 do
+      group_run(name, arity, [NC(n2, p2, b2) | acc], rest)
+    else
+      [Grp(name, arity, rev_ncs(acc, [])) | group([NC(n2, p2, b2) | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def rev_ncs(Vec(NClause), Vec(NClause)) Vec(NClause)
+  def rev_ncs([], out) := out
+  def rev_ncs([c | rest], out) := rev_ncs(rest, [c | out])
+
+  def funcs(Vec(Grp)) Vec(Func)
+  def funcs([]) := []
+  def funcs([Grp(name, arity, ncs) | rest]) := [Func(name, arity, clauses_of(ncs)) | funcs(rest)]
+
+  def clauses_of(Vec(NClause)) Vec(Clause)
+  def clauses_of([]) := []
+  def clauses_of([NC(_, pats, body) | rest]) := [Clause(pats, GNone, Block([SExpr(body)])) | clauses_of(rest)]
+
+  def plen(Vec(Pat)) Int53
+  def plen([]) := 0
+  def plen([_ | rest]) := 1 + plen(rest)
+
+  # ── inflate selfhost_beam's Form sum -> real abstract-form tuples ──
+  # (rung 7's inflater, extended with FNil/FCons for list patterns).
+  def inflate_funcs(Vec(FFunc)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def inflate_funcs([]) := []
+  def inflate_funcs([f | rest]) := [inflate_func(f) | inflate_funcs(rest)]
+
+  def inflate_func(FFunc) Tuple
+  def inflate_func(FFunc(name, arity, clauses)) := {:function, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(name), arity, inflate_clauses(clauses)}
+
+  def inflate_clauses(Vec(FClause)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def inflate_clauses([]) := []
+  def inflate_clauses([c | rest]) := [inflate_clause(c) | inflate_clauses(rest)]
+
+  def inflate_clause(FClause) Tuple
+  def inflate_clause(FClause(pats, guard, body)) := {:clause, 0, inflate_all(pats), guard_seq(guard), inflate_all(body)}
+
+  def guard_seq(GForm) Vec(Vec(Tuple))
+  def guard_seq(GfNone) := []
+  def guard_seq(GfSome(g)) := [[inflate(g)]]
+
+  def inflate_all(Vec(Form)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def inflate_all([]) := []
+  def inflate_all([f | rest]) := [inflate(f) | inflate_all(rest)]
+
+  def inflate(Form) Tuple
+  def inflate(FInt(v)) := {:integer, 0, v}
+  def inflate(FVar(n)) := {:var, 0, var_atom(n)}
+  def inflate(FAtom(a)) := {:atom, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(a)}
+  def inflate(FNil) := {:nil, 0}
+  def inflate(FCons(h, t)) := {:cons, 0, inflate(h), inflate(t)}
+  def inflate(FOp1(op, x)) := {:op, 0, op_atom(op), inflate(x)}
+  def inflate(FOp2(op, l, r)) := {:op, 0, op_atom(op), inflate(l), inflate(r)}
+  def inflate(FCall(f, args)) := {:call, 0, {:atom, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(f)}, inflate_all(args)}
+
+  def var_atom(n String) Symbol := Prim.str_to_atom(cap(n))
+
+  def op_atom(String) Symbol
+  def op_atom("+") := :"+"
+  def op_atom("-") := :"-"
+  def op_atom("*") := :"*"
+
+  def parse_int(s String) Int53 := digits(Prim.str_chars(s), 0)
+  def digits(Vec(Int53), Int53) Int53
+  def digits([], acc) := acc
+  def digits([c | rest], acc) := digits(rest, acc * 10 + c - 48)
+
+  def cap(s String) String
+    case Prim.str_chars(s) do
+      [c | rest] -> Prim.str_from_chars([up(c) | rest])
+      [] -> s
+    end
+  end
+
+  def up(c Int53) Int53
+    if c >= 97 and c <= 122 do
+      c - 32
+    else
+      c
+    end
+  end
+end

+defmodule Rian.ComposeRealDeclFixpointTest do
+  # async: false — loads verified ports (by their natural atoms) + the driver, and
+  # the driver loads compiled modules at runtime.
+  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
+
+  alias Rian.Beam
+
+  # COMPOSITION fixpoint rung 9 (ADR-0063 Step 3): the front-end's LAST toy piece —
+  # declaration splitting — is replaced by the equivalence-locked `selfhost_decl`
+  # port. `selfhost_compose_real_decl.rian` parses the whole program with
+  # `SelfhostDecl.parse_program` (cross-module), lowers its Decl IR to `selfhost_beam`
+  # Core/Pat (the surface→Core lowering), and compiles via the verified `selfhost_beam`
+  # backend (cross-module). BOTH front-end (lex→SelfhostDecl) and back-end
+  # (SelfhostBeam) are now verified ports.
+  #
+  #   lex → SelfhostDecl.parse_program → normalize/group → lower → SelfhostBeam.compile_forms
+  #        → inflate (in Rian) → :compile.forms / :code.load_binary
+  #
+  # selfhost_decl's surface has no `if` (that was rung 8's selfhost_parse) but DOES
+  # have cons-list patterns — so this rung compiles list-pattern recursion
+  # (`sum`/`len`), beyond rung 8. The test loads both ports under their
+  # :"Elixir.Selfhost*" atoms, then calls only `build/2` and runs the result,
+  # identical to `Rian.Beam`.
+
+  setup_all do
+    {:ok, _} = Beam.load(File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_decl.rian"), :"Elixir.SelfhostDecl")
+    {:ok, _} = Beam.load(File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_beam.rian"), :"Elixir.SelfhostBeam")
+
+    {:ok, drv} =
+      Beam.load(
+        File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_compose_real_decl.rian"),
+        :rian_compose_real_decl
+      )
+
+    {:ok, drv: drv}
+  end
+
+  defp ref_module(src) do
+    {:ok, m} = Beam.load(src, :"cmp_rd_ref_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}")
+    m
+  end
+
+  # {pipeline source (untyped), reference source (typed sigs), [{fn, args}] to run}.
+  @corpus [
+    {
+      "def fib(0) := 0\ndef fib(1) := 1\ndef fib(n) := fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)",
+      "def fib(n Int53) Int53\ndef fib(0) := 0\ndef fib(1) := 1\ndef fib(n) := fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)",
+      [{:fib, [0]}, {:fib, [1]}, {:fib, [10]}, {:fib, [15]}]
+    },
+    {
+      "def fact(0) := 1\ndef fact(n) := n * fact(n - 1)",
+      "def fact(n Int53) Int53\ndef fact(0) := 1\ndef fact(n) := n * fact(n - 1)",
+      [{:fact, [0]}, {:fact, [6]}]
+    },
+    {
+      "def even(0) := 1\ndef even(n) := odd(n - 1)\ndef odd(0) := 0\ndef odd(n) := even(n - 1)",
+      "def even(n Int53) Int53\ndef even(0) := 1\ndef even(n) := odd(n - 1)\ndef odd(n Int53) Int53\ndef odd(0) := 0\ndef odd(n) := even(n - 1)",
+      [{:even, [8]}, {:even, [7]}, {:odd, [8]}, {:odd, [5]}]
+    },
+    # list-pattern recursion — beyond rung 8's (if-based) surface
+    {
+      "def sum([]) := 0\ndef sum([h | t]) := h + sum(t)",
+      "def sum(xs Vec(Int53)) Int53\ndef sum([]) := 0\ndef sum([h | t]) := h + sum(t)",
+      [{:sum, [[]]}, {:sum, [[1, 2, 3, 4]]}, {:sum, [[10, -3, 5]]}]
+    },
+    {
+      "def len([]) := 0\ndef len([_ | t]) := 1 + len(t)",
+      "def len(xs Vec(Int53)) Int53\ndef len([]) := 0\ndef len([_ | t]) := 1 + len(t)",
+      [{:len, [[]]}, {:len, [[1, 2, 3]]}, {:len, [[9]]}]
+    }
+  ]
+
+  describe "verified front-end + back-end fixpoint — runs identically to Elixir" do
+    test "build/2 (SelfhostDecl + SelfhostBeam) loads modules equal to Rian.Beam's", %{drv: drv} do
+      for {rian_src, ref_src, calls} <- @corpus do
+        modname = :"cmp_rd_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}"
+        loaded = drv.build(rian_src, modname)
+        assert loaded == modname
+
+        ref = ref_module(ref_src)
+
+        for {fname, args} <- calls do
+          assert apply(loaded, fname, args) == apply(ref, fname, args),
+                 "driver(real decl+back) `#{fname}` diverged from Elixir toolchain on #{inspect(args)}"
+        end
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "teeth — the declaration parser AND backend are the verified ports" do
+    test "list-pattern clauses lower to cons forms and run (sum over a list)", %{drv: drv} do
+      m = drv.build("def sum([]) := 0\ndef sum([h | t]) := h + sum(t)", :rd_sum_teeth)
+      assert apply(m, :sum, [[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]]) == 15
+    end
+
+    test "compile_module groups multi-clause defs via the real decl parser", %{drv: drv} do
+      [_m, {:attribute, 0, :export, exports} | funcs] =
+        drv.compile_module(
+          "def fib(0) := 0\ndef fib(1) := 1\ndef fib(n) := fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)",
+          :rd_fibs
+        )
+
+      assert exports == [{:fib, 1}]
+      assert [{:function, 0, :fib, 1, clauses}] = funcs
+      assert length(clauses) == 3
+    end
+
+    test "an empty-list pattern lowers to the nil form `{nil, 0}`", %{drv: drv} do
+      [_m, _e, {:function, 0, :f, 1, [c0 | _]}] =
+        drv.compile_module("def f([]) := 0\ndef f([_ | t]) := t", :rd_nil)
+
+      assert {:clause, 0, [{nil, 0}], [], [{:integer, 0, 0}]} = c0
+    end
+  end
+end
